title: Roman Soldier's Enlistment
author: Ancient
content:
ENLISTMENT PRELIMINARIES 
     from Egypt 

Oxyrhynchus,  A.D. 51. 
 

Copy of a release.  Year 12 of Emperor Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus,  Pharmuthi 29, Augustan.
Released by Gnaeus Vergilius Capito, Praefectus of both ( Egypt and Alexandria? ):  Trypho son of Dionysios, weaver, from the Metropolis of Oxyrhynchus, suffering from cataract impairing his vision.  Examined and certified in Alexandria.

Papyrus Oxyrhynchus 
39 = Ulrich Wilcken, 
Chrestomathie
 #456.
